name: Enterprise Initiative and Business Case
constraints: WM-ACT-030 remains the only Initiative root and its identity survives business-case revisions, gates and rejection.
Idea, request or ticket becomes an Initiative only through explicit registration with case for change, mandate and accountable sponsor.
Formalization into Project, Program or operation mints a new master identity and records typed derivation, scope mapping and handover.
Ticket, approval and budget line never create delivery identity.
Business Case is an immutable versioned release contained by Initiative and is explicitly superseded.

Alternative receives an Initiative-scoped stable option key from the Initiative allocator and is referenced by key across releases; label-based rebinding is prohibited while appraisal values remain release-local.

Every comparison uses release-local copies or pinned external revisions for criteria, horizon, currency, price base, valuation basis, metric revisions, method and uncertainty; no unmastered pin-set object is shared across releases.
Option sets include a do-nothing or business-as-usual comparator unless an explicit exception is recorded.
Mandatory and compensatory criteria remain distinct and incomparable dimensions are not netted without a declared method.
Assumption, Hypothesis and Forecast remain distinct and reference their external masters.
Every Assumption, Hypothesis, Risk/Opportunity and Budget reference pins an immutable revision or snapshot value; live-only pointers are forbidden.

Investment Decision is addressed by its WM-REC-010 issued record; WM-ACT-024 is the temporal occurrence anchor and any decision label is narrative only. WM-REC-010 freezes the complete join to rationale, occurrence, case release and funding facts.
Mandate, approval, funding authorization, allocation, release, availability and realized benefit remain distinct assertions.
Alternative forecasts sharing one expected benefit identity are mutually contextual and never summed.

An expected benefit shared by Alternatives is a pinned WM-KNW-015 Opportunity reference; contained expected-benefit content is allowed only inside one Alternative's release-local appraisal, and no Benefit master is invented.
Budget authorization, allocation, release and availability remain WM-ECO-012-mastered references and are never remastered by Initiative.
The issued decision records both the pinned WM-ECO-012 revision or snapshot and the exact funding state kind used at decision time.
Decision reconstruction pins the original input package and preserves rejected initiatives, alternatives and rationale.
Rejection issues a WM-REC-010 record under the same frozen-join discipline as approval.
Rejected Initiatives retain identity, releases, appraisals and rejection records; cascade deletion and identity reuse are forbidden.
Realized benefit is out of profile and is mastered by the formalized delivery identity; the Initiative never accretes post-formalization delivery facts.
Business Case supersession is a directed historical link and no decision resolves through a supersession chain.
Portfolio-first capital decisions without a single Initiative remain WM-ACT-029-owned and are outside this profile.
WM-ACT-029 portfolio decisions are never retro-mapped into Initiative mandates.
Unallocated Outcome, Benefit and Metric referents are never promoted silently.
holds: WM-ACT-030 and adjacent drafts remain non-canonical single-provider results.
The WM-ACT-005 registry parent conflicts with the Initiative-is-not-Project boundary.
Approved relation contracts for initiative, case, option, decision, budget and formalization are absent.
Outcome or Benefit Realization and Metric Definition referents remain unallocated.
Composition coverage, source pins, crosswalks, mastership confirmation and canonical fixtures remain incomplete.
The single frozen audit was remediated without a repeat; canonical publication authority was not granted.
